name: chronicle
description: Turns a brief plus the material a researcher subagent digests (notes, files, transcripts, links) or company facts from the sources plugin into an illustrated, interactive story page designed for its subject: a theme, progress bar, paper and words from the subject's world, checked against other pages so no two look alike, ink-and-watercolor drawings painted in code, rigged animals that walk and graze, panoramas, rooms and map tours to explore, quizzes played as golf holes, pen notes, editorial charts, maps, flows, diagrams, a widget library, and a source behind every number. Also makes standalone painted, rigged and drawn animations in the same style, exported as SVG, HTML, PNG, GIF and MP4 for web pages, docs, chat and slides; architecture diagrams moved to the blueprint plugin.
